source.name: UAE Tour - Sponsors page (Presenting Sponsor)
source.note: The sponsors page lists 'Presenting Sponsor' with the AD Ports Group logo (Logo-ADPG-2026.webp, link to adportsgroup.com); ADSC's 10 Sep 2026 release confirms the partnership was 'established in 2026' and continues in 2027.

note: Presenting Sponsor of the men's UAE Tour; also a classification-jersey sponsor and a stage sponsor (AD Ports Group Stage, stage 7). Fee not published.
